# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Hub William is a continuously deployed static site. Only the latest revision on
the `main` branch is supported with security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue or discussion for a suspected vulnerability.
Email `william.sontran.dev@gmail.com` with:

- a concise description of the issue and its impact;
- the affected URL, file, or commit;
- reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept; and
- any suggested mitigation, if you have one.

You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days. Please allow time to
confirm the report and prepare a fix before publishing details. If the report is
accepted, the maintainer will coordinate disclosure and credit with you.

Never include real credentials, personal data, or secrets in a proof of
concept. Use clearly fake values and the smallest reproduction that demonstrates
the problem.
